title: Isolate Git configuration in the incoming-commit audit test
outcome: The Windows incoming-commit audit fixture runs Git only inside its owned repository with isolated configuration and explicit identity.
acceptance: The incoming_commit_audit_reads_complete_real_git_selection fixture uses the hardened Git command and disables ambient system/global configuration, hooks and templates through the repository's supported fixture helper.
The fixture retains meaningful real-Git selection assertions and cannot be redirected by inherited GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE or GIT_INDEX_FILE.
